shared_widgets.name: AppTopBar
shared_widgets.description: App bar with title, optional back affordance (48dp), and CartBadgeButton. Uses surface/on_surface tokens. Preserves list filter/search in ProductListNotifier when navigating back from detail.

shared_widgets.name: CartBadgeButton
shared_widgets.description: Icon button (min 48×48dp) showing shopping cart with numeric badge from CartNotifier item count. Semantic label includes count, e.g. Cart, 3 items. Navigates to /cart.

shared_widgets.name: ProductCard
shared_widgets.description: Catalog list tile: product image or ImagePlaceholder (semantic label = product name), name (title_medium), tax-inclusive price from integer minor units + ISO 4217 via PriceText, OutOfStockChip when stock <= 0. Entire card is one 48dp-min tap target navigating to /products/:id.

shared_widgets.name: PriceText
shared_widgets.description: Formats integer minor units (cents) with currency code (e.g. USD) as tax-inclusive display string. Never uses floating-point money. Uses price/price_large or price_medium tokens.

shared_widgets.name: OutOfStockChip
shared_widgets.description: Compact availability chip using out_of_stock/on_surface colors; text Out of stock; exposed to screen readers as product unavailable.

shared_widgets.name: CategoryFilterBar
shared_widgets.description: Horizontal chip row for Apparel, Accessories, Home, Essentials (plus All). Selected chip uses primary_container. Each chip min height 48dp. Updates ProductListNotifier.categorySlug.

shared_widgets.name: SearchField
shared_widgets.description: Text field filtering product names; clear button restores full list. Hint Search products; semantics announce result count changes. Min touch target 48dp for clear icon.

shared_widgets.name: ImagePlaceholder
shared_widgets.description: Surface-variant block with product icon when image URL missing/fails; always paired with semantic label describing the product.

shared_widgets.name: PrimaryButton
shared_widgets.description: Filled CTA using primary/on_primary; min height 48dp; disabled state for out-of-stock or stock-limit (reduced opacity, not focusable as enabled). Used for Add to cart.

shared_widgets.name: QuantityStepper
shared_widgets.description: Minus / quantity label / plus controls; each control ≥48dp. Quantity never below 1 unless line removed; plus disabled at mock stock limit with clear semantics.

shared_widgets.name: EmptyStateView
shared_widgets.description: Centered illustration/icon, title, body message, optional retry for empty catalog or empty cart. Uses body_large and on_surface_variant.

shared_widgets.name: ErrorStateView
shared_widgets.description: Error icon, message, Retry button (48dp) that reloads LocalCatalogDataSource / notifier. Meets WCAG AA contrast on background.

shared_widgets.name: LoadingStateView
shared_widgets.description: Centered CircularProgressIndicator with semantic label Loading products or Loading product details; blocks interaction until AsyncValue resolves.

shared_widgets.name: CartLineItem
shared_widgets.description: Cart row: name, PriceText unit snapshot (cents + currency), QuantityStepper, remove (48dp). Reflects CartNotifier; remove deletes line.

shared_widgets.name: StockAvailabilityLabel
shared_widgets.description: Shows In stock (N available) or Out of stock using success/out_of_stock colors; used on detail for default variant.

screens.name: ProductListScreen
screens.purpose: Browse mock catalog with product cards (name, tax-inclusive price from cents + USD, image/placeholder, out-of-stock), category filter, name search, and cart badge. Initial route for M1; serves discovery without auth or backend.

screens.name: ProductDetailScreen
screens.purpose: Show single product name, tax-inclusive price (cents + currency), image, description, category, and stock for default variant; Add to cart for in-stock items; back returns to list with filter/search preserved.

screens.name: CartScreen
screens.purpose: Session-only in-memory cart: line items with name, unit price snapshot (cents + currency), quantity controls, remove; enforce min qty 1 unless removed and max qty = mock stock; empty on process restart.

navigation.trigger: Tap ProductCard with product id → go_router push /products/:id
Back / AppTopBar leading → pop; ProductListNotifier keeps categorySlug and search query
Back from cart or Continue shopping when empty → pop or go /products
Successful Add to cart (optional snackbar action View cart) → push /cart

accessibility: Minimum touch target 48×48dp for all interactive controls (cards, chips, icons, steppers, buttons, clear search).
Text and icon contrast meet WCAG AA: on_background/on_surface on background/surface ≥ 4.5:1; primary on on_primary and error/on_error pairs verified for light and dark.
All product images and ImagePlaceholders expose Semantics label with product name; decorative icons excludeSemantics or labeled.
CartBadgeButton announces Cart, N items; OutOfStockChip and StockAvailabilityLabel announce availability to TalkBack.
PrimaryButton Add to cart disabled when out of stock or at stock limit; Semantics hint explains why (Out of stock or Maximum stock reached).
LoadingStateView uses live region / Semantics label so screen readers hear Loading… then content.
EmptyStateView and ErrorStateView provide readable titles/body; Retry is focusable and labeled Retry loading products.
QuantityStepper minus/plus have labels Decrease quantity and Increase quantity; quantity value is a Semantics value.
Focus order: search → category chips → product list → cart badge; on detail: back → cart → image → content → quantity → add.
Do not rely on color alone for out-of-stock: chip text plus optional strike or badge pattern.
Support system text scaling; price and titles reflow without clipping on common phone widths (≥320dp).
No personal data, passwords, or payment fields in M1; nothing to announce as secure entry.
